name: Parmenter household

facts.text: The Parmenter household: Eabae (49), Anwynd (48), Ethel (44), Byrht (43) and Burgraed (43, aggro 0) Parmenter, ghosts, no faction, no spells, respawn 80 s, at the south-east end of the dyers' hamlet (~432.6-432.9k, 392.6-392.9k).
facts.source: world data: Mob/NpcTemplate tables (0.37b runtime database, world tables only)

facts.text: The household's trades and each member's habit are Living Server writing.

story:
The colleges of Avalon let the dales to tenant families who farmed and wove and dyed and kept bees for them, and when the war came the families died in their houses in the first summers and stayed. A drakoran rod holds them there now. The Parmenters were the hamlet's tailors.

Eabae Parmenter cut the colleges' gowns, the readers' black and the masters' furred, and still measures every visitor with a look as if for a robe nobody will pay for.

Anwynd Parmenter kept the peace between the Dyers and the Tinctors, badly, and still stands between their houses.

Ethel Parmenter sewed, and counts stitches aloud, and loses count at the same place every time.

Byrht Parmenter carried bolts of cloth to the colleges by cart and is still waiting for the cart.

Burgraed Parmenter, the eldest, sits by the hearth and never rises against anyone. Gracien Adamson thinks Burgraed is the only one who knows the household is dead.
legend: The Parmenter household: five ghosts at the south-east end of the dyers' hamlet, Eabae (49), Anwynd (48), Ethel (44), Byrht (43) and Burgraed (43). All aggro on sight except Burgraed, who never starts a fight. They stand close, so you often get two or three: pull from the edge. Plain melee, no spells, respawn 80 seconds. The whole house comes back in about a minute and a half, so clear it and move on rather than resting inside.
